message:
Cabinet Monitor:A water flow failure was detected on the BRM cooling system.
The system goes to Emergency Stop State.
Please contact your Service Representative and check cooling system with them->

Heat Exchanger Cabinet (HEC) detected customer coolant temperature is out
of specification (too high). 
Please verify that the facility coolant temperature and flow is within
specification.
This alarm will not stop scanning->

Heat Exchanger Cabinet (HEC) detected the cryogen compressor flow rate
is too high.
This alarm will not stop scanning->

Cabinet Monitor:Leak Sensor1 detects sensor fault.
Please contact your Service Representative and check or replace it with them.->

RF coil airflow sensors measurement warning detected.
Measurement difference: 40 percent
Warning Tolerance: 40 percent->

Heat Exchanger Cabinet (HEC) detected the cryogen compressor flow rate
is too low.
This alarm will not stop scanning->

Gradient coil temperature high.
Protective automatic shutdown likely if temperature continues
to rise.

Cabinet Monitor:A water flow failure was detected on the cabinet cooling system.
The system goes to Emergency Stop State.
Please contact your Service Representative and check cooling system with them.->
